likely_message_or_issue: App crashes, hangs, shows blank globe or unfinished state
root_cause_checks: Reproduce exact submitted IPA; inspect startup, network, WebGL and lifecycle logs
required_remediation: Fix root cause; add Economy fallback; remove endless loader
regression_evidence: Exact-build crash, launch and WebGL tests; video; fix commit
metadata_or_console_update: Update review notes and known limitations only when truthful
owner_action: Select the corrected build and resubmit
resubmission_gate: New build number; full Apple smoke green

likely_message_or_issue: Reviewer cannot access account, child mode, store or protected feature
root_cause_checks: Check credential health, backend, OTP, biometric and regional dependency
required_remediation: Provide durable review account/PIN and exact steps without owner intervention
metadata_or_console_update: Replace App Review Information credentials and instructions
resubmission_gate: Access health green for exact build

likely_message_or_issue: Child can purchase or follow an external link without parental gate
root_cause_checks: Test Back, deep link, restart, share, store and route restore
required_remediation: Fix Parent Gate and pre-render child policy; add bypass tests
regression_evidence: Parent Gate E2E matrix and video
metadata_or_console_update: Explain exact gate path in Review Notes
owner_action: Approve corrected child flow and resubmit

likely_message_or_issue: Kids Category or child-facing claims conflict with SDK, data or links
root_cause_checks: Review category selection, SDKs, data flow, metadata and external actions
required_remediation: Remove incorrect category/claims or fully comply after owner/legal decision
metadata_or_console_update: Update category, age band and metadata
resubmission_gate: Owner approval and all store fields consistent

likely_message_or_issue: Age rating understates adult literary themes
root_cause_checks: Review whole-binary content inventory and questionnaire answers
required_remediation: Correct questionnaire and/or access controls; disclose sensitive themes

likely_message_or_issue: IAP is unavailable, not restorable or not reviewable
root_cause_checks: Check product state, paid agreements, sandbox, StoreKit and backend verification
required_remediation: Fix configuration/code; expose Restore; provide exact test path
regression_evidence: Purchase, pending, restore, refund and revocation tests
metadata_or_console_update: Submit IAP/build together and update Review Notes
owner_action: Complete App Store Connect product/agreement fields

likely_message_or_issue: Account creation exists without in-app deletion
root_cause_checks: Audit all account entry points, deletion and retention
required_remediation: Implement discoverable in-app deletion and server workflow
metadata_or_console_update: Update privacy policy and Review Notes

likely_message_or_issue: App Privacy, privacy manifest or policy differs from SDK/network behavior
root_cause_checks: Compare code, SDKs, native declarations, traffic and backend data
required_remediation: Correct code or declarations; remove unjustified SDK
regression_evidence: Network diff and privacy schema tests

likely_message_or_issue: Screenshots or description show unavailable/unlicensed features
root_cause_checks: Compare listing assets to exact RC and rights manifest
required_remediation: Remove, recapture or rewrite; exclude concept collage
resubmission_gate: Every claim and image maps to RC

likely_message_or_issue: Rights for portraits, covers, characters, maps or audio not proven
root_cause_checks: Audit asset manifest, licenses, platform, territory and term
required_remediation: Remove asset or supply adequate scoped rights evidence
regression_evidence: Rights-clean binary scan and evidence dossier
metadata_or_console_update: Remove trademarked listing content when needed
owner_action: Supply legal evidence or approve removal

likely_message_or_issue: Build uses unsupported Xcode or SDK
root_cause_checks: Check build identity against current Apple requirement
required_remediation: Rebuild with accepted Xcode and iOS/iPadOS SDK

likely_message_or_issue: Intended paid app is configured free or was publicly offered free
root_cause_checks: Inspect Play Console status, history and package
required_remediation: Block rollout; configure paid before first public release; decide on new package if already free
metadata_or_console_update: Set price, countries and payments profile

likely_message_or_issue: Reviewer cannot access restricted app content
root_cause_checks: Validate App Access instructions, account, PIN and backend
required_remediation: Provide reusable credentials and all steps without OTP

likely_message_or_issue: Target audience or Families answers conflict with child UI
root_cause_checks: Compare selected ages, mascot, content, SDK, store and data behavior
required_remediation: Correct declarations and child implementation
resubmission_gate: Exact RC and console answers align

likely_message_or_issue: Data Safety or privacy policy mismatch
root_cause_checks: Audit traffic, SDKs, accounts, purchase verification and child data
required_remediation: Fix data flow or declarations; update policy
regression_evidence: Release traffic scan and deletion tests
metadata_or_console_update: Update Data Safety, privacy and deletion URL

likely_message_or_issue: Deletion unavailable in app or external web
root_cause_checks: Audit account creation, deletion routes and retention
required_remediation: Implement both required paths
metadata_or_console_update: Set deletion URL and privacy wording

likely_message_or_issue: Sensitive/restricted permission is unjustified
root_cause_checks: Inspect merged manifest, plugins and runtime prompts
required_remediation: Remove permission or justify it and implement denial path

likely_message_or_issue: Digital product bypasses Play Billing or purchase lifecycle is broken
root_cause_checks: Inspect checkout links, Billing version, verification, pending and acknowledgement
required_remediation: Use compliant current purchase path; fix backend lifecycle

likely_message_or_issue: Crash, ANR, broken button, blank globe or old target API
root_cause_checks: Inspect pre-launch report, exact AAB, target API and device matrix
required_remediation: Fix, rebuild and update target/toolchain
resubmission_gate: No P0/P1; current target gate green

likely_message_or_issue: Misleading title, screenshots, claims or unauthorized marks
root_cause_checks: Compare exact RC, listing and rights evidence
required_remediation: Correct listing and recapture screenshots

likely_message_or_issue: Application appears to only redirect to a website
root_cause_checks: Verify offline/local globe, navigation and content capabilities
required_remediation: Ensure complete standalone product and document it
regression_evidence: Offline standalone flow video and tests

likely_message_or_issue: Moderator cannot authorize or see all functions
root_cause_checks: Validate test account, PIN, demo/review mode and backend
required_remediation: Provide stable credentials and full path

likely_message_or_issue: App without free functionality is not marked Paid or price is missing
root_cause_checks: Inspect console app type, monetization and price
required_remediation: Configure Paid and monetization

likely_message_or_issue: Third-party IP or official claim lacks evidence
root_cause_checks: Audit rights manifest, brand, characters and assets
required_remediation: Remove or provide documents

likely_message_or_issue: Prohibited or unjustified sensitive permission
root_cause_checks: Inspect APK manifest and plugin source
required_remediation: Remove or give sufficient purpose and fallback

likely_message_or_issue: Link to Google Play, App Store or other storefront is found
root_cause_checks: Scan binary, UI, deep links and update messages
required_remediation: Remove competitor-store links from RuStore variant

likely_message_or_issue: Version is lower than another store or signature mismatches
root_cause_checks: Check release train, version code and certificate
required_remediation: Synchronize release and rebuild with correct signing

likely_message_or_issue: Listing name/screenshots differ from installed/current app
root_cause_checks: Compare installed label, exact APK and captures
required_remediation: Align identity and recapture exact build

likely_message_or_issue: Crashes, freezes, errors or layout issues
root_cause_checks: Run exact APK on device matrix
required_remediation: Fix and add fallback/regression

likely_message_or_issue: Disney/Pixar or protected asset/name appears without license
root_cause_checks: Scan binary, manifests, screenshots, metadata and remote packages
required_remediation: Remove entirely or supply signed scoped license and approvals

likely_message_or_issue: Adult content is reachable from child mode
root_cause_checks: Test search, direct ID, deep link, cache, history, offline and restart
required_remediation: Fix deny-by-default pre-render policy

likely_message_or_issue: Reviewer misunderstanding or nonreproducible finding
root_cause_checks: Restore exact submitted build, credentials, backend health and instructions
required_remediation: Improve access/notes if needed and provide factual evidence
metadata_or_console_update: Clarify notes only; do not hide behavior
